reviewed_experiments.interpretation: Broad grader smoke; memory transient write failures are useful diagnostics.
Most diagnostic real-chain run; exposed task non-convergence, loopDetection, null cards, and cost overruns.
Failure-preserving challenge set; useful for error analysis, not a strong benchmark.
Best current synthetic baseline for memory lifecycle behavior.
Metric coverage is good, but data is too templated to prove retrieval generalization.
Journey direction is right; persona and input diversity need redesign before it becomes a strong benchmark.
Grounding and citation assertions pass, but data audit shows template-heavy retrieval data.
Best current synthetic baseline for memory lifecycle, including Super Agent grounded QA.
Failure-preserving challenge set with stratified audit; useful for error analysis and data redesign priorities.
Best current retrieval slice for showing production-like inputs; small curated baseline, not a replacement for real replay.
Expanded production-like retrieval slice with 12 users, 78 inputs, and 47 tasks; useful for harness engineering and data-construction discussion, still retrieval-only fixture.
Scaled production-like retrieval slice with 24 users, 150 inputs, and 94 tasks; richer metrics, but input naturalness dipped to 0.85 so the next step should be replay or raw-document realism.
Style and domain texture improved, but large generated retrieval set remains structurally templated.
PKM source-id loop is fixed, but the challenge set remains too templated for benchmark claims.

recommended_next_steps: Calibrate LLM judge on 20-50 real replay outputs with human review.
Expand production-like retrieval and journey data with per-scenario source structures instead of template substitution.
Extend production-like complexity from retrieval-only fixture to memory, PKM, Super Agent, and real replay.
Add a rule-based post-check for LLM audit summaries that use absolute coverage words such as every/all.
Use the full_chain_medium replay failure as the next real product debugging entry point.
Rebuild hard-case challenge families while preserving seed failures and source-grounded oracles.
Require every new benchmark report to state evidence level and what the run cannot prove.
